AcquisitionReport.description: Visits per day and channel, every channel named, and the top sources: the source is the campaign source, else the referring host, else "(direct)", taken from the first page view of the visit that carries a channel.

BatchRequest.description: A batch of events from the browser, sent as text/plain or application/json. More than 50 events answer 413.

DevicesReport.description: Visits and conversions (null without a conversion event) per value, sorted by visits: the top five values and "other" for the rest, unknown countries included.

ErrorResponse.description: A stable machine key in error and a message for humans that never echoes input.

FeaturesReport.description: The 50 most used named events (kind=events) or screens by page views (kind=screens), with the visits they appear in and one daily count per day of the range.

FunnelReport.description: How many visits (mode=visit) or identified people (mode=user) reached each step, in order: a step counts only at or after the first time the previous one happened.

IncomingEvent.description: One event. An event that breaks these rules is counted as rejected while the rest of its batch is kept.

IngestResult.description: What happened to each event of the batch.

Me.description: The signed-in admin and the projects they may read.

OverviewReport.description: Visits, identified users, conversions (null without a conversion event) and failed writes of the range against the previous one, with one daily entry per day of the range.

RequestCodeRequest.description: The email to send a sign-in code to.

RequestsReport.description: Writes (methods other than GET) per route, the most failing first: a failure is status 0 or 400 and above. Screens are the pages the calls were made from; at most five recent failures per route, newest first.

SignedIn.description: The signed-in admin; the session travels in a cookie.

VerifyCodeRequest.description: The email and the six-digit code it received.

info.description: Privacy-first product analytics: event ingestion, dashboard queries and erasure of a user's events. No cookies on tracked visitors, no personal data, no IP address or user agent stored.
info.title: Pyxis API

post.description: Public route, authenticated by the project key in the body and the Origin header. Invalid events are counted as rejected; the rest of the batch is stored. A resent event is a duplicate, never stored twice.

400.description: The body is not JSON or does not match BatchRequest.

401.description: The key is unknown or revoked.

403.description: The Origin header is missing or not one of the project's origins.

413.description: The body exceeds 32,768 bytes or holds more than 50 events.

429.description: Too many batches from this address or for this project.
